Game Overview

Triangle Back to Home is a platformer title where guide a whimsical triangular paper figure through enchanting landscapes filled with obstacles in a quest to return home. Time your jumps and strategize to overcome challenges, enhance abilities, and gather power-ups. With intuitive controls, immerse yourself in this captivating journey of precision and strategic thinking.
